parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup mode. Valid values: 
* **Automated**: automatic backup.
* **Manual**: manual backup.

parameters.name: BackupRegion
parameters.description:
The destination region for cross-region backups.

> Currently, only PolarDB for MySQL supports this parameter.

parameters.name: BackupStatus
parameters.description:
The backup status. Valid values:
* **Success**: The backup is complete.
* **Failed**: The backup failed.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Set the value to an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 
* **30**
* **50**
* **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC).
